csv.inference: advisory; default Text until explicit type acceptance
csv.quotes: RFC4180 doubled quotes and embedded CR/LF
csv.empty: missing; explicit fill or leave missing
csv.locale: finite decimal Number and Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD Date only; ambiguous strings remain Text
csv.export: selected sheet; formulas become current calculated values; formats/styles/other sheets are disclosed losses; formula-leading literal Text/headers are rejected, use typed XLSX

native_equivalent: numeric + - * / and binary MIN/MAX formulas with plain/cross-sheet A1 references
converted: TRUE()/FALSE() constants to Boolean with ledger
source A1 coordinates to stable semantic references
preserved_readable: basic bold/fill/wrap/border/alignment and declared column widths
unsupported_safe_disabled: hidden/veryHidden worksheets or hidden rows/columns/default rows
unmapped worksheet children or row/column attributes
mixed Number/Date/time semantics across numeric format sections
table/validation rules not represented by adapter
date_rejections: time-only and elapsed-time values including integral serials
export_loss: unsupported parts and legacy execution are never emitted

operations: split into selected existing Text destinations
explicit conversion into selected typed destination while retaining source
cleanup.schema_boundary: column typing and optional cleanup output columns are selected before import; cleanup uses existing typed semantic publication

editing: reuse stock scalar/formula editor and stable-ID sort/filter projection; no second formula evaluator
persistence: existing direct-ro/v2 or frozen roproj/v1 private host record; source metadata and presentation share the same atomic browser record

fidelity.export: explicit disclosure and user acknowledgement before download; preserve working source project
fidelity.unknown: fail closed for semantic constructs without a declared mapping

acceptance: messy CSV explicit typing and cleanup through ordinary UI
two-sheet typed/formula XLSX UI import and edits
independent reference-tool reopening and formula comparison

native_tables_export.xlsx: All native scalar tables in canonical collection-key order. Rust derives display names, fields and rows; typed Text/finite Number/Boolean/Gregorian Date, yyyy-mm-dd. Refuse any unmapped or field-constrained collection, never truncate data or headers.
native_tables_export.names: Worksheet display names sanitized, Unicode-safely truncated to 31 UTF-16 code units, case-insensitively disambiguated with suffixes and Converted mapping findings. Headers sanitized and disambiguated without truncation.
native_tables_export.csv: Requested collection key or stable schema ID only; scalar lexical values, explicit loss of typing/formatting. One nonblocking lossy_on_export native_tables_csv_blank_empty_text finding at the selected stable schema ID iff an optional Text field has an absent or present empty Text value in exported rows; either is an empty CSV field. No such finding for XLSX, excluded collections, empty tables, required Text, optional Number or only nonempty Text. Other collections disclosed individually. Refuse field constraints in the selected collection and XML-illegal Text/headers with located findings. Existing formula-leading Text/header refusal remains.
native_tables_export.missing: Absent optional fields map to Empty in their rectangular position.
native_tables_export.incoming_asymmetry: Incoming typed spreadsheet profile remains 4 sheets, 16 columns and 64 data rows; the separate Text-capacity exception is unchanged. Outbound success does not promise reimportability.

imported_workbook_export.structure: Current explicit display-name headers use existing compatibility mapping; absent explicit names retain source headers. Surviving source rows/columns retain order and identity-bound styles/widths; new rows/columns append in current canonical order with default presentation; removed columns and deleted rows are omitted. Blanks are empty cells; formulas rebind to current absolute A1. Same after Undo and v3/package reopen with retained host metadata.
imported_workbook_export.limits: Existing shared output profile and separately admitted Text-capacity exception only; native authoring capacity never widens export.
imported_workbook_export.refusal: Whole export, no bytes: imported_spreadsheet_export_refused with located typed diagnostic, specific compatibility code or imported_spreadsheet_unrepresentable. Every current schema must be mapped.
imported_workbook_export.csv: Selected sheet only; blank and present empty Text both become empty CSV fields, disclosed in csv_values_only; existing formula-leading Text/header refusal remains.
